_comment: THE ORGO PLAN MAP (BH-5748). One entry per Orgo account the fleet buys computers on.
Read by bin/box-launch.sh: --account <key> picks the entry. Editable here, in git,
because plan limits and prices are business facts and not code constants.
plan: the Orgo plan name. key_env: the env var that holds this account's API key.
template_ref: the Orgo template a new box is created from (the claude-code template).
null = not recorded; box-launch --apply refuses until it is set.
cost_account: the key in catalog/cost-accounts.json .accounts that box-register.sh
--account gets for a box made here. register_like: box-register.sh --like <box-id>
(project-6-os carries the @reboot sshd/tailscaled line of an Orgo claude-code box).
limits: max_vcpus_per_computer is the plan cap per computer; ram_tiers_gb are the only
RAM sizes a computer can have.
pool: the account-level add-on pool (computers, vCPU, RAM GB, disk GB). Capacity is a
MONTHLY pool, so a box uses its share for the whole month. null = not recorded;
box-launch --apply refuses (never assumes free capacity) until it is set.
prices_usd_mo: monthly add-on price per computer, per vCPU, per RAM GB, per disk GB.
null = not recorded; a request that needs that price is refused.
defaults: the specs box-launch uses when a --vcpus/--mem-gb/--disk-gb flag is absent.
disk_gb null = no disk size is sent and none is priced.
Source: Orgo billing, as recorded in docs/SCALE-PLAN-2.md on 2026-07-31 (startup_v2:
4 vCPU per computer cap, RAM tiers 4/8/16/32 GB, $4/GB/mo, $10/vCPU/mo, $1/mo per computer).
